title: xunit V3 discovery regression / behavior change

labels.name: Bug
labels.description: A fault in an existing feature

body:
Hey,

Apperantly the discovery in src\xunit.v3.core\Framework\TestFrameworkDiscoverer.cs changed to include any classes in the assembly.
As such, if any class contains an attribute with invalid parameters (sample below), the discovery will fail.

1. From visual studio prespective, nothing is written
"11:48:53:033	No test is available in XXX Make sure that test discoverer & executors are registered and platform & framework version settings are appropriate and try again." 
2. When run the test project from visual studio (some tests appear, probably before the crash) you will get this:
"12:52:08:198	========== Starting test run ==========
12:52:08:275	========== Test run aborted: 0 Tests (0 Passed, 0 Failed, 0 Skipped) run in < 1 ms =========="

When running from the .exe itself, the stack is clear:

```
System.InvalidOperationException: user error...
   at System.Reflection.CustomAttribute.CreateCustomAttributeInstance(RuntimeModule module, RuntimeType type, IRuntimeMethodInfo ctor, IntPtr& blob, IntPtr blobEnd, Int32& namedArgs)
   at System.Reflection.CustomAttribute.AddCustomAttributes(ListBuilder`1& attributes, RuntimeModule decoratedModule, Int32 decoratedMetadataToken, RuntimeType attributeFilterType, Boolean mustBeInheritable, ListBuilder`1 derivedAttributes)
   at System.Reflection.CustomAttribute.GetCustomAttributes(RuntimeType type, RuntimeType caType, Boolean inherit)
   at System.Attribute.GetCustomAttributes(MemberInfo element, Boolean inherit)
   at Xunit.Sdk.ReflectionExtensions.GetMatchingCustomAttributes(Type type, Type attributeType) in /_/src/xunit.v3.common/Extensions/ReflectionExtensions.cs:line 234
   at Xunit.v3.TestCollectionFactoryBase.Get(Type testClass) in /_/src/xunit.v3.core/Framework/TestCollectionFactoryBase.cs:line 37
   at Xunit.v3.XunitTestFrameworkDiscoverer.CreateTestClass(Type class) in /_/src/xunit.v3.core/Framework/XunitTestFrameworkDiscoverer.cs:line 58
   at Xunit.v3.TestFrameworkDiscoverer`1.<>c__DisplayClass10_0.<<Find>b__0>d.MoveNext() in /_/src/xunit.v3.core/Framework/TestFrameworkDiscoverer.cs:line 76
--- End of stack trace from previous location ---
   at System.Threading.Tasks.Task.<>c.<ThrowAsync>b__128_1(Object state)
   at System.Threading.QueueUserWorkItemCallback.Execute()
   at System.Threading.ThreadPoolWorkQueue.Dispatch()
   at System.Threading.PortableThreadPool.WorkerThread.WorkerThreadStart()
```

Minimal example to reproduce:
```csharp
public class DummyAttribute : Attribute
{
    public DummyAttribute (int value)
    {
        if ( value == 5 ) throw new InvalidOperationException("value is invalid!");
    }
}
```

And use that on any class (doesn't need to be a class related to a test).
```csharp
[DummyAttribute(5)]
public class DummyClass{}
```

So:
1. I suggest better logging in case of an exception during discovery, it took me a while
2. I suggest only invalid tests will be discarded in case of a failure (e.g. add a catch in the Find method inside TestFrameworkDiscoverer)
3. Consider filtering only relevant classes (tody the method `IsValidTestClass`) will return any non-abstract (or sealed) class

P.S
To clarify why we have such a case (which I presume is rare), we have xunit running static code anlaysis checks, and we created a double check for some attribute (SCA + runtime exception)
